name: Selkie
production_model: Designed in LA, made in China

prices.note: All 305 items in the dresses collection (216 Dresses, 89 Gowns) are regular price (no compare_at above price). 290 have a size in stock ($149–$1,500). Median $359. Low end: The Eclipse Dublin Pinafore $109 (sold out), The Phantom Chemise $149; top: The Queen Of Angels Silk Gown Made to Order $1,500. Puff dresses $249–$335 (Rainbow Puff Dress $290, Ivory Puff Dress $259).

notes: About: 'Fanciful, nostalgic and extra romantic. By former Wildfox Co-Founder, Kimberley Gordon.' 'Selkie offers a range of stand out party dresses, and after party sweatsuits.' Sizes 'XXS-6X'. (pages/about-selkie)

Learn more: designed in Silverlake, LA; 'works hand in hand with a talented manufacturing team in China'; manufacturer 'WRAP certified and BSCI certified'; 'We cut very small runs of inventory and pre sell many of our best sellers'; 'Some garments have only 15-20 ever made'; 'not 100% sustainable due to the use of polyester'.
meta.json: shop address Reno, Nevada, US; currency USD; ships_to_countries includes '*' and US, CA, GB, AU.
Size chart XXS (bust 31-33in) to 6X (bust 60-64in); 'Hips are free-size unless noted'; 'Designed to be height inclusive' (no tall range).

Shipping: domestic and international $20, free over $350 (after gift cards/discounts); orders shipping from more than one location may be charged $40 (refund of $20 on request); 'as we ship most of our items from China we do not offer expedited shipping'; international 7-10 working days, buyer pays import fees; Canada/US territories may route via its LA warehouse (up to 2 weeks processing).

Returns: file within 15 days of delivery, then 15 more days to post; one exchange allowed; return shipping deducted from refund or credit; sale items over 25% off, final sale, mystery bags and sample sale are non-returnable; no returns for items worn at events, photoshoots or on social media.
